subject: POC environment landing plan — connectivity & secrets checklist
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aaliyah Thompson <aaliyah.thompson@nisunimbus.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC environment landing plan — connectivity & secrets checklist

Hi Aaliyah —

Thanks for the call earlier. Per our MAP draft, I pulled together a concise landing-plan focused on the POC environment dependencies so we can lock a target close and avoid late blockers. Please review the items below and confirm owners + target dates from your side by EOD Friday.

POC target close: 2027-07-09 (customer acceptance test window 2027-07-12 to 2027-07-16)

Network & infra dependencies (high priority)
- VPC peering: Nimbus to Redwood VPC (requires VPC IDs, preferred CIDR, and peering contact) — owner: Nimbus (Dan Park) — action: request peering config by 2027-06-18
- IP allowlists / outbound firewall rules: list of egress IP ranges we will use (example attached) — owner: Nimbus infra — action: add ranges to allowlist by 2027-06-20
- NAT / egress behavior: confirm whether connection is via NAT gateway or static egress IP (affects ACLs) — owner: Nimbus infra

Identity & secrets (security-critical)
- SSO / SAML: confirm IdP-initiated vs SP-initiated flow, SAML metadata + cert, test user account — owner: Nimbus security (please share SAML metadata by 2027-06-20)
- KMS / secrets: policy for storing API keys and whether customer-managed KMS key is required (we support AWS KMS/HSM) — owner: Nimbus security / compliance — action: confirm KMS requirement by 2027-06-18

Test access & validation
- Staging test account: create one test tenant + one service account with the minimal role for POC by 2027-06-21
- Sample dataset upload: small sample (<=100 MB) for latency testing — owner: Nimbus product

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan with milestones), network-acls-example.txt (sample IP ranges)

Please confirm the named owners above or propose alternates. Once you confirm, we (Redwood) will assign engineering owners and add a short runbook to the MAP for the execution window.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

—
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0197

From: Aaliyah Thompson <aaliyah.thompson@nisunimbus.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dan Park <dan.park@nisunimbus.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:34:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC environment landing plan — connectivity & secrets checklist

Thanks, Priyom — this is great and much clearer than my notes. Quick answers and a few questions inline: 

- VPC peering: Dan (cc'd) will own. We can provide VPC IDs and CIDRs by EOD Thursday (2027-06-17). One note: we have a corporate policy that peering requests must be reviewed by network security — Dan, can you confirm schedule?

- IP allowlist: we can accept a /28 block for the POC. Can you confirm whether Redwood requires TCP port 443 only, or are there additional ports for telemetry?

- SSO / SAML: Nimbus prefers IdP-initiated. We can share metadata and certs, but our SAML cert rotation is monthly — will that be a problem for the POC? Also, will Redwood require JIT provisioning or just SAML assertions for SSO?

- KMS / secrets: We prefer to use our CMK (customer-managed key) for production, but for the POC we can use Nimbus-managed keys if Redwood supports them.

Next steps from our side: Dan and I will confirm owners and deliverables (VPC IDs, test account) by 2027-06-17. We may need a short (30m) session with your infra engineer to walk the peering workflow — can we book that for next week?

Thanks —
Aaliyah
Head of Product Partnerships | Nimbus Retail
aaliyah.thompson@nisunimbus.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aaliyah Thompson <aaliyah.thompson@nisunimbus.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: RE: POC environment landing plan — connectivity & secrets checklist

Hi Aaliyah, Dan —

Thanks for the quick replies. To make this actionable, below is an ownership matrix and the short-runbook we'll add to the MAP. Priyom and I will be the Redwood points for execution during the POC window; Olga will handle any security policy reviews.

Ownership / responsibilities (Redwood vs Nimbus)
- VPC peering: Nimbus (Dan) to request peering + provide VPC ID/CIDR by 2027-06-17. Redwood (Marissa) to accept peering and verify route propagation by 2027-06-18.
- IP allowlist / ports: Nimbus to add Redwood ranges; Redwood provides final egress list (attached: network-acls-example.txt). Ports: TCP 443 mandatory; additional telemetry ports are optional — we'll default to 443 for the POC.
- SAML / SSO: Nimbus (security) to provide SAML metadata + cert (preferred IdP-initiated) by 2027-06-20. Redwood supports IdP-initiated flows; we do not require JIT provisioning for the POC (we can create service accounts manually). Olga, please see the attached SSO integration guide for cert rotation notes.
- KMS / secrets: For the POC we can use Nimbus-managed keys; if you want CMK in production we'll document that as a follow-on. Nimbus to confirm by 2027-06-18.
- Test access: Nimbus to create a staging test tenant with one admin/test user by 2027-06-21. Redwood will validate connectivity and run a smoke test within 24 hours of access confirmed.

Runbook snapshot (to be attached to MAP)
1) Nimbus provides VPC peering request + details -> 2) Redwood accepts peering and validates routes -> 3) Nimbus apply IP allowlist -> 4) Nimbus share SAML metadata/test user -> 5) Redwood validates SSO + secrets access -> 6) Smoke tests and performance probe -> 7) Acceptance window begins 2027-07-12

Attachments: redwood-sso-integration-guide.pdf (SSO cert rotation and test steps), MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (updated to show owners above)

Karthik — can you add the short runbook and updated milestone dates to the HubSpot deal and drop the DocuSign link for the MAP once Nimbus confirms owners?

Thanks —
Marissa
Program Manager, Customer Onboarding | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Great — thanks everyone. Per the timeline above I've scheduled the infra handoff call for Thursday 2027-06-24 10:00 PT and shared a calendar invite. Action items we have on deck: 

- Dan: VPC IDs + CIDRs by 2027-06-17 (in progress)
- Dan / Nimbus infra: add Redwood IP ranges to allowlist (target 2027-06-20)
- Nimbus security: SAML metadata + test user (target 2027-06-20)
- Nimbus security: confirm KMS choice for POC (2027-06-18)
- Redwood (Marissa): accept peering and validate routes after peering is created

I'll update the MAP and ping Karthik to publish the DocuSign link when Nimbus confirms owners. Attaching the MAP-draft-v1.xlsx to this thread for visibility.

Looking forward to the call on Thursday.
